crunchyroll-revanced.description: Crunchyroll ReVanced is a patched version of the official Crunchyroll app (package com.crunchyroll.crunchyroid) using ReVanced tools. It primarily applies the 'Hide ads' patch, which removes video ads (pre-roll, mid-roll, post-roll) and general ads for a smoother viewing experience on free accounts. Evidence from official ReVanced patches and community discussions indicates this is the main (and often only) functional patch available for Crunchyroll—no reliable unlock of full premium features like offline downloads, HD streaming without limits, or ad-free simulcasts exists in standard or custom ReVanced repositories. Attempts at other patches (e.g., older 'Enable downloads') have historically caused crashes or been removed due to incompatibility.
